question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
-- The career spans look reasonable. Now let me compute the average.

WITH player_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        LEAST(TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) AS earlier,
        GREATEST(TRY_CAST(debut AS DATE), TRY_CAST(final_game AS DATE)) AS later
    FROM player
    WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''
),
calc AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        earlier,
        later,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM later) AS ld,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM earlier) AS ed,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM later) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM earlier)) * 12 + 
            (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM later) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM earlier)) AS total_months_raw
    FROM player_dates
),
calc2 AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        earlier,
        later,
        CASE 
            WHEN ld < ed THEN total_months_raw - 1
            ELSE total_months_raw
        END AS total_months_adj
    FROM calc
),
calc3 AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        earlier,
        later,
        CAST(FLOOR(total_months_adj / 12.0) AS INTEGER) AS years,
        CAST(total_months_adj % 12 AS INTEGER) AS months
    FROM calc2
),
calc4 AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        earlier,
        later,
        years,
        months,
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM earlier) AS INTEGER) + years + 
            CASE WHEN CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM earlier) AS INTEGER) + months > 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intermediate_year,
        CASE WHEN CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM earlier) AS INTEGER) + months > 12 
            THEN CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM earlier) AS INTEGER) + months - 12 
            ELSE CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM earlier) AS INTEGER) + months END AS intermediate_month,
        CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM earlier) AS INTEGER) AS ed2
    FROM calc3
),
calc5 AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        years,
        months,
        DATE_DIFF('day',
            TRY_CAST(
                CAST(intermediate_year AS VARCHAR) || '-' || 
                CAST(intermediate_month AS VARCHAR) || '-' || 
                CAST(ed2 AS VARCHAR)
            AS DATE),
            later
        ) AS days
    FROM calc4
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(
        ROUND(ABS(years), 2) + ROUND(ABS(months), 2) / 12.0 + ROUND(ABS(days), 2) / 365.0
    ), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM calc5
